title.zh: 核聚变为什么总是“还要三十年”
title.en: Why Is Fusion Always Thirty Years Away?

desc.zh: 从原子质量、库仑势垒、隧穿和劳森判据，到托卡马克、惯性约束、氚与中子，再到截至 2026 年的实验纪录和 1976 年的经费规划。十一个可以动手调的模型。
desc.en: From atomic masses, the Coulomb barrier, tunnelling and the Lawson criterion to tokamaks, inertial confinement, tritium and neutrons, then the records as of 2026 and the 1976 funding plan. Eleven models you can push.

desc.zh: 从原子质量算出每核子结合能和反应的 Q 值：D–T 每千克放出的能量约是铀裂变的五倍、标准煤的一千多万倍。
desc.en: Binding energy per nucleon and reaction Q-values from atomic masses: per kilogram, D–T releases about five times as much as uranium fission and over ten million times as much as coal.

zh: 核聚变和核裂变的区别
en: where does fusion energy come from
energy per kilogram of fusion fuel

title.en: The Coulomb barrier and thermal motion

desc.zh: D–T 之间约 444 keV 的电荷排斥墙；麦克斯韦分布的尾巴里，经典上几乎没有粒子翻得过去。
desc.en: A wall of about 444 keV of electric repulsion between D and T; classically almost no particle in the Maxwellian tail gets over it.

en: why does fusion need 100 million degrees

title.zh: 隧穿、伽莫夫峰与反应率
title.en: Tunnelling, the Gamow peak and reactivity

desc.zh: 隧穿几率乘麦克斯韦尾巴形成伽莫夫峰；Bosch–Hale 的 ⟨σv⟩ 说明为什么大家都选 D–T。
desc.en: Tunnelling probability times the Maxwellian tail gives the Gamow peak; the Bosch–Hale ⟨σv⟩ shows why everyone chooses D–T.

en: how does the sun fuse with tunnelling

title.en: Lawson criterion and the triple product

desc.zh: 产热要跟上漏热：n·T·τ_E 在约 14 keV 处有最低门槛，约 3 × 10²¹ keV·s/m³ 才能点火。
desc.en: Heating must keep up with losses: n·T·τ_E has its lowest ignition threshold near 14 keV, about 3 × 10²¹ keV·s/m³.

title.zh: 磁约束：漂移与扭转磁场
title.en: Magnetic confinement: drifts and twisted fields

desc.zh: 环形磁场里的粒子会垂直漂移撞壁；把磁力线拧起来（托卡马克电流或仿星器线圈）才能抵消。
desc.en: In a toroidal field particles drift vertically into the wall; twisting the field lines (tokamak current or stellarator coils) cancels the drift.

zh: 磁场怎么关住等离子体

title.zh: 约束定标律与高温超导

desc.zh: ITER98(y,2) 定标律下的零维托卡马克：Q 怎样随尺寸和磁场变，为什么高场磁体能让装置变小。
desc.en: A 0-D tokamak with the ITER98(y,2) scaling: how Q depends on size and field, and why high-field magnets shrink the machine.

zh: 聚变装置为什么这么大
en: why are fusion reactors so big

desc.zh: 把燃料压到上千倍密度、靠 ρR 烧掉一部分；NIF 的靶增益与电站需要的增益差在哪。
desc.en: Compress fuel a thousandfold and burn a fraction set by ρR; how NIF's target gain compares with what a power plant needs.

desc.zh: 等离子体增益不等于电站增益：热电转换、加热效率和厂用电之后，Q_sci 要到几十才像一座电站。
desc.en: Plasma gain is not plant gain: after thermal conversion, heating efficiency and house load, Q_sci must reach tens to look like a power plant.

en: what does Q mean in fusion

title.zh: 氚增殖、中子损伤与偏滤器
title.en: Tritium breeding, neutron damage and the divertor

desc.zh: 电站要自己造氚（TBR > 1）、扛住 14 MeV 中子，还要把废热从毫米宽的通道排到靶板上。
desc.en: A plant must breed its own tritium (TBR > 1), survive 14 MeV neutrons and exhaust heat through a millimetre-wide channel onto the divertor.

title.zh: 聚变前沿：纪录与开放问题
title.en: The fusion frontier: records and open problems

desc.zh: 截至 2026 年的三重积纪录、NIF 点火实验、JET 能量纪录、长脉冲和各方计划，区分已演示与声明。
desc.en: Triple-product records to 2026, NIF ignition shots, JET's energy record, long pulses and announced plans, separating demonstrated results from claims.

zh: 核聚变什么时候能商用

desc.zh: 1976 年 ERDA 规划把示范堆日期绑在经费曲线上，实际拨款低于“永远造不出”的那条线；另一种解释是物理比预想的难。
desc.en: The 1976 ERDA plan tied the demonstration date to a funding curve, and actual budgets fell below the 'never' line; the other view is that the physics was harder than expected.

zh: 为什么聚变总是还要三十年
en: why is fusion always thirty years away
